audience: security, fraud and analytics teams that enrich IP addresses with ipdata data

useCases.title: Locate an IP address
useCases.text: Look up the city, region, country, time zone, currency and carrier of one IP address. Pass fields to get only some of the data.

useCases.title: Screen an IP address for threats
useCases.text: Check whether an IP address is a Tor exit, proxy, datacenter address or known attacker, and read the blocklists it appears on.

useCases.title: Find the company behind a network
useCases.text: Read the organisation that an IP address network is assigned to, with its domain and usage type.

useCases.title: Look up an autonomous system
useCases.text: Read one AS number with its organisation, prefixes, registry, country, and upstream, downstream and peer networks.

useCases.title: Enrich a list of IP addresses
useCases.text: Look up as many as 100 IP addresses in one call. Each address uses one request of the daily ipdata quota, and the replies keep the input order.
